findings.title: Missing content-security-policy
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the content-security-policy response header.
findings.remediation: Set a strict Content-Security-Policy that avoids unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.

findings.title: Missing strict-transport-security
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the strict-transport-security response header.
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS for HTTPS responses with a long max-age and includeSubDomains if appropriate.

findings.title: Missing x-frame-options
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the x-frame-options response header.
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN unless framing is required.

findings.title: Missing x-content-type-options
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the x-content-type-options response header.

findings.title: Missing referrer-policy
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the referrer-policy response header.
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy to strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter.

findings.title: Missing permissions-policy
findings.evidence: https://example.com does not return the permissions-policy response header.
findings.remediation: Set Permissions-Policy to restrict powerful browser features.

findings.title: Server banner exposed
findings.remediation: Reduce unnecessary version disclosure in public headers where possible.
